lifecycle_detail: Feedback received; developing the next release from 1 session
release_notes: Added an atomic JSON-backed runtime-store fallback when the native SQLite binding is unavailable, while retaining SQLite as the preferred backend.
Added fallback persistence, multi-instance queue claiming, and recovery-to-SQLite support.
Added automated coverage for fallback durability and queue behavior.
Preserved the new first-person 3D stage, perspective-aware controls, fullscreen button and shortcuts, improved ball trails, catcher rail, and telemetry fixes.
Validated all orchestrator, game-logic, and main-scene tests successfully.
